EventBridge Scheduler A
cron 0 8 * * ? * SGT
retry_policy.max_retry_attempts = 0

span.p:
EventBridge Scheduler B
cron 15 8 * * ? * SGT
retry_policy.max_retry_attempts = 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lambda 'waf-report-trigger' (60s)
• run_id = uuid4()
• S3 PUT markers/{date}/{run_id}.json
{status:'started', started_at:now}
• lambda.invoke('runner', Event)
• return in <2s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lambda 'waf-report-healthcheck' (60s)
retries=0
1. list_objects_v2(markers/{today}/)
2. For each marker:
• status='completed' → OK
• status='started' ∧ age > 12min
→ PIPELINE TIMEOUT alert
3. purge markers >7d old

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lambda 'waf-report-runner' (900s)
event_invoke_config.max_retry_attempts = 0
boto3 Config(retries={max_attempts:1},
read_timeout=850)
• invoke_agent_runtime(supervisor, sync)
• on completion: S3 PUT marker {status:'completed'}
• on Lambda timeout: marker stays 'started'
